texts.name: Text_Cosmo_Intro
texts.text:
"Hey! Hey, wake up!"  
"Oh, thank the stars. You're alive!"  
"I'm COSMO. Your ship's AI."  
"We crashed. Badly."  
"See that light? That's our ticket home."  
"Come on, partner. Let's move!"

texts.name: Text_Cosmo_Victory
texts.text:
"WE DID IT!"  
"Haha! I knew you could do it!"  
"Look at that. The Star Core is ours."  
 "Not bad for our first day on an alien planet."  
"Now... let's go home, partner."

texts.name: Text_Cosmo_GameOver
texts.text:
Oh no! We were so close!
Hey, don't worry! We'll get it next time.
That Star Core isn't going anywhere.
We've learned a lot from this mission.
Come on, partner. Let's give it another shot!
